name: Alpha Partner USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Alpha Partners' BSC dollar token with claimed off-chain fiat backing; reserve assets, custodians and independent reports remain undisclosed.
collateral: AlphaPartners' USDA article dated 2025-10-22 claims 1:1 off-chain fiat reserves regularly audited by independent third parties. It identifies no reserve assets, weights, custodians, auditor, report period or reconciliation cadence. The current AP U-Card website and GitBook do not supply those USDA-specific disclosures. Historical FDIC-protection marketing remains unsubstantiated; FDIC insurance does not cover stablecoins.
pegMechanism: Undocumented. The issuer publishes no mint/redeem or peg-maintenance mechanism. On-chain USDA is a BSC ERC-20 with a role-gated mint, an address blacklist, and modifiable transfer tax/fees; no peg-stabilization process is described.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDA presents an issuer-controlled one-dollar reserve claim; weak disclosures affect evidence quality but not the mechanism family.
